name: Mount Vernon Volunteer Program
org: George Washington's Mount Vernon (Mount Vernon Ladies' Association)
what_you_do: Help at George Washington's home. You might work in the dig lab, greet guests, help at events (some in old-time clothes), work in the gardens, or help the actors who play people from history.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Volunteers get discounts at the estate's shops and restaurants and special tours.
duration: At least 25 hours a year to stay active.
deadline_text: The page said volunteer applications were closed as of Oct 16, 2026, with no reopening date.
how_to_apply: Check the volunteer page to see when it opens again. You can also call Joan Flintoft at 703-799-8605.
notes: About 250 active volunteers. Some roles, like driving, need an adult with a license, so not every role is open to teens. There is no archaeology fieldwork for volunteers right now, only lab work. The site blocked automated reading on Nov 4, 2026, so call to confirm.
